correctness.rationale: The coordinate bitangents cancel two fourth powers; on the other lines z=A x+B y with A^4=B^4=1, the quartic restricts to 2(x^2+(B/A)xy+(B/A)^2y^2)^2 by expansion. Over every odd characteristic these give 28 distinct lines and two distinct rational lifts each. Each lift has anticanonical degree one and self-intersection -1 by adjunction, exhausting the 56 exceptional curves of a geometric degree-two del Pezzo. Two distinct bitangents cannot meet on the smooth branch curve: even intersection multiplicity there would make both the unique tangent. Thus their lifted intersection is transverse precisely when the quadratic roots agree at their meeting point. This equality criterion specializes uniformly: in the cyclotomic ring the two values are equal or opposite, and after every odd-characteristic specialization neither vanishes. A same-line pair meets with intersection number two by intersecting its anticanonical sum with one lift, so gives no edge. Substitution of zeta^q gives the four automorphisms, with delta=zeta-zeta^3 fixed for residues 1,7 and negated for 3,5; odd residues are their own inverse. Independently I reconstructed the labeled graph and actions over two split fields (17 and 41) as checks of these algebraic rules, found 756 edges and the exact reduced determinant 2^128*3^35*7^26, then used exact Hermite indices modulo successive prime powers with a successive-difference divisor basis. This gives the full primary spectra and confirms all four rows and the (56,0,0,8) fixed-vertex counts for involutions having the cycle types stated. The reduced determinant independently supplies prime support, including ruling out any omitted primes. The equivariant perfect pairing justifies passing from coinvariant factors to abstract fixed groups. The frozen support script computes the prime-local spectra but does not itself recompute the claimed independent reduced determinant; the replay here checks that determinant separately.
residual_risks: The finite-field samples check the construction but are not the proof of odd-characteristic stability. The graph is intersection-one only and no assertion is made for characteristic two or arbitrary twists.

value.rationale: This is the natural intersection-one graph of the entire exceptional-curve configuration. Beyond the already available full group, the refinement sharply separates two naturally arising Frobenius symmetries having the same splitting data: the 7-primary fixed ranks are 14 and 20 for residues three and five. The four-case answer provides integral information for all odd finite fields without confusing cycle types with finite-group descent or claiming surface Picard torsion.
residual_risks: The usefulness established is for this arithmetic graph invariant, not a general theorem on del Pezzo surfaces or on all Weyl-group symmetries.
